public.text: Cost recovery and shared-benefit arrangements are mentioned but no safeguards are provided against user fees, provider exclusion, or inequitable access.
public.suggestedRevision: Require financing mechanisms to protect essential use, subsidise low-resource participants, ensure non-discriminatory access, and assess distributional impacts before introducing fees or contribution requirements.
